destinations.title: Destinations
destinations.intro: Every destination runs browser and server delivery with shared deduplication, consent gating and per-event status.
destinations.noneText: Add an ad platform, analytics tool, affiliate network or webhook. The wizard walks through credentials, mappings and a verified test event.
destinations.catalogIntro: All destinations ship with browser tag, server API, hybrid deduplication, credential validation, retries and health monitoring.

wizard.title: Setup wizard
wizard.prerequisitesNone: No special access required beyond an active account with the vendor.
wizard.modeText: Hybrid sends every event from the browser tag and from the server with the same event id, so the vendor deduplicates. Server-only avoids any vendor script on your site.
wizard.testMode: Test mode (events flagged as test at the vendor where supported)
wizard.idsText: Public identifiers are not secrets and may be entered here.
wizard.settingsText: Optional vendor settings such as test event codes or per-event conversion ids.
wizard.settingsNone: This destination has no additional settings.
wizard.settingsJsonHelp: Map canonical event names to vendor ids, one per line: event=id
wizard.credentialsText: Secrets go straight into the encrypted vault and are validated with the vendor. They are never shown again and never reach the assistant.
wizard.validateText: Runs the cheapest vendor read or validate-only call with the stored credentials and records the result as the destination health.
wizard.consentText: This destination needs the purpose "{purpose}". Without that consent nothing is loaded in the browser and nothing is sent from the server. Inferred consent is never exported to advertising platforms.
wizard.clickIdsText: The tracker captures these parameters from landing pages only after marketing consent and passes them to this destination: {params}. Nothing else is forwarded.
wizard.clickIdsNone: This destination does not use click identifiers.
wizard.mappingsText: Choose which canonical events go to this destination. Leave the vendor event empty to use the verified default mapping.
wizard.dedupText: Browser and server events share the event id. This destination deduplicates on "{field}"; purchases additionally carry the order id.
wizard.snippetText: The browser tag is loaded by the Track snippet after consent — no additional code on your site. Check that the snippet is installed.
wizard.testText: Sends a flagged test event through the real pipeline in test mode and waits for this destination's delivery result.
wizard.vendorCheckText: Confirm the test event in the vendor tool: {hint}
wizard.offlineText: Send offline or CRM conversions to the server API with a source key; they reach this destination with action source "offline" where the vendor supports it.
wizard.offlineUnsupported: This vendor accepts web events only; offline conversions are not forwarded.
wizard.qualityText: Lints the whole draft: required ids, consent purposes, mappings and field maps.
wizard.reviewText: Prepares the publish diff: every change, affected events and data recipients.
wizard.publishText: Publishing creates an immutable, signed configuration version. Roll back at any time.
wizard.monitorText: Delivery status, health checks and recent attempts for this destination.
